svg.text: Integration-safety system — defense-in-depth tiers
Each PR is routed through cheap static gates first; the expensive live suite is reserved for affected work and post-merge attribution.
cost / time per PR → increasing
Tier 0 — Contract gate (every PR · seconds · no backend)
GraphQL breaking-change diff vs main + UI operation validation · schema drift + codegen · terraform fmt/tflint
Catches: field/enum/arg/nullability removals, UI ops referencing dropped fields, schema↔resolver drift, HCL lint.
check-schema.yml
Tier 1 — Hermetic checks (every PR · minutes · mocked)
nx affected lint/typecheck/test/build · hermetic E2E (@critical) with route.fulfill mocks
Catches: UI regressions, type errors, unit failures, build breaks. (Existing — unchanged.)
ci-pipeline.yml
Tier 2 — Selective live (risky PRs only · minutes · live backend / real AWS)
Advisory comment lists affected specs (surface map) · run:integration runs only that subset
Speculative terraform plan as read-only plan role — surfaces IAM/refresh/destroy errors before merge.
Catches: real UI/backend flow breaks, terraform breakage that would block deploys.
integration-advisory.yml
terraform-plan.yml
Tier 3 — Per-merge + nightly (post-merge · full cost · live backend)
Affected specs run per merge to main for instant attribution · full suite nightly as backstop
Stop-the-line on red: file + notify with the implicated commit, warn PRs touching the broken area.
Phase 2 (designed; per-merge attribution + stop-the-line not yet built).
run-playwright-tests.yml
